studying-06: I never play truant because I don't want to miss important lessons. If I am ill and have to stay at home, I ask a classmate for their notes and catch up later.
hometown-01: I come from a small town in central Vietnam. I was born and raised there, and it's known for its beautiful countryside and friendly people.
hometown-02: What I like most about my hometown is the peaceful atmosphere. I can go for a walk in the evening without the noise and crowds of a big city.
hometown-03: The one thing I don't like is the limited number of job opportunities. Some young people have to move to a larger city to find work.
hometown-04: Young people in my town often meet at cafés or in the local park. They usually chat, have a drink and spend time together after school.
friends-01: Yes, I have a few close friends. We've known each other for years, and I trust them because they're always there when I need help.
friends-02: My best friend is someone I met at school. What I like most about her is that she listens carefully and gives honest advice when I have a problem.
friends-03: I meet my friends about once a week, usually at the weekend. We often go to a café or play a sport together.
friends-04: I usually keep in touch with my friends by sending messages. We also call each other when we're busy, but I prefer meeting in person whenever possible.
friends-05: Yes, I once had an argument with a friend about a misunderstanding. We talked about it later, apologised to each other and made up.
friends-06: Yes, I have a friend I met in an online language group. We sometimes practise English together and send messages to stay in touch.
friends-07: It can be difficult for me at first because I'm a little shy. However, I find it easier to make friends when we share an interest, such as music or sport.
hobbies-01: In my free time, I like reading and going for a walk. Reading helps me relax, while walking gives me a chance to get some fresh air.
hobbies-02: Yes, I think hobbies are important because they help us take a break from work or study. For example, playing an instrument can help someone relax and learn a new skill.
hobbies-03: I'd like to try photography in the future. I enjoy visiting new places, so I think taking photos would help me notice more details around me.
tea-coffee-01: Both tea and coffee are popular in Vietnam. Many people have coffee with friends at a café, while tea is often offered to guests at home.
tea-coffee-02: Yes, when we have guests, I usually offer them some tea. I ask if they would prefer coffee, then prepare whichever drink they like.
tea-coffee-03: I had a cup of tea yesterday evening at home. I drank it while talking to my family after dinner.
languages-01: I speak Vietnamese and some English. Vietnamese is my first language, and I'm still practising English so that I can communicate more confidently.
languages-02: I'd like to learn Japanese in the future because I'm interested in the culture. I hope to take a beginner's course when I have more free time.
languages-03: Yes, learning a new language can be difficult, especially when the pronunciation is unfamiliar. However, listening and practising a little every day can make it easier.
music-01: Yes, I enjoy listening to music, especially when I'm travelling or relaxing at home. It helps me unwind after a busy day.
music-02: I usually listen to pop music because the melodies are easy to remember. I also like quieter songs when I need to concentrate.
music-03: I like singing along to songs at home, although I'm not a very confident singer. Sometimes I sing karaoke with my friends just for fun.
